name: Gencsapáti (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light grey over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gencsapáti: a crowned blue shield with a white chapel and ears of grain on a green mound, within a green wreath, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gencsapáti arms with crown, wreath and scroll
